## What's changed

- Limit clipboard image previews to the capsule size and display scale, keep their aspect ratio, and release the loaded image when the preview closes. Capsule animations no longer change the decode size.
- Move Wi-Fi refreshes off the UI thread. Read NetworkManager access point properties with one `GetAll` call, coalesce refresh requests, discard stale results, and retain the previous list on refresh failure. Improve iwd type registration and network discovery signals.
- Share CPU, memory, and root filesystem sampling across screens. Sample only while the corresponding information is visible, reuse cached values, and stop polling after the last subscriber leaves. CPU readings now share a single baseline instead of interfering across screens.
- Replace per-screen `df` processes with background filesystem queries while preserving reserved-space accounting and percentage rounding.
- Use the same JSON comment parser in the shell and settings application. Preserve literal comment markers, URLs, escaped quotes, backslashes, UTF-8 text, and original error offsets.
- Add regression tests for preview sizing and release, delayed Wi-Fi services, multi-screen sampling, subscription cleanup, and configuration round trips.

## Validation

- Release build and all 15 CTest suites pass.
- Installer script tests pass.
- Installed QML, backend libraries, and settings application were checked together; the running service was restarted successfully.

## Installation

Arch Linux / AUR:

```sh
paru -Syu tide-island
```

For a source installation, download `tide-island-source.tar.xz` and `SHA256SUMS`, verify the checksum, extract the source, and run `./install.sh`.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/enhaoswen/Tide-island/compare/1.0.41...1.0.42
